source.retention: local-only archive; binary is not added to Git

ordinaryDeath.result: Experience is not read, divided, subtracted, capped, or written. No experience mutation helper is called. The branch restores HP/mana, recalculates secondary stats, relocates, saves, and reports remaining lives.
ordinaryDeath.runtime: RuntimeCharacterDeathResolver records before/after/loss markers and preserves the exact long Experience value when at least one life remains.

requirements: the player's Keep Some Experience option is enabled
the departing character level is greater than 1

tenPercentCandidate.representation: native split high/low experience value is divided exactly; Reforged long division is equivalent

finalDeathOrReroll.runtime: RuntimeClassicDeathExperienceAuthority exposes/regression-tests the exact calculator and RuntimeCharacterService.RerollCharacter now applies the result to the freshly built replacement character before RuntimeCharacterRepository.ReplaceCharacter atomically replaces the old account slot.

correctedHypotheses: Normal death does not remove 10 percent of experience.
There is no level-under-10 ordinary-death exemption because ordinary death has zero XP loss at every level.
There is no 2,000,000 cap in the recovered final-reroll retention calculation.
The native 10 percent operation retains experience for a replacement character; it is not an ordinary-death penalty.
